scores.tell: Muted purple-grey wall and lilac table; books are fully saturated primaries (blue, magenta, green) with a dull, cool-grey background, unlike real cards' clean, vivid backdrop.
none; vivid cyan-blue ground, natural leather browns, and warm orange wood match real card palettes.
none; saturated navy hero against yellow-orange ground with a cyan accent matches the real hue roles. The pi pattern is a bit warm-heavy.
The grey-lilac stone and the scene's many hue families (green, blue, tan, yellow) are somewhat natural and muted. The grass is a bit dull compared with the real swing card.
The moon scene is mostly grey-lilac with little chroma. Only the blue dome and a small yellow door carry color, so the card lacks the real cards' loud hero and background.
none; purple hat with a violet band and gold buckle sits on a saturated orange ring backdrop, a clean hue role split like the real cards.
The dark green forest and muddy brown ground are muted and dark. The orange stew and fire work as an accent, but the card is more naturalistic than real cards and has less chroma overall.
Hot magenta background is a bit louder than real cards. The palm leaves, trunk, and sand are well chosen, so it is plausible, but the pink may be too intense.
Hot pink stripes against a navy cauldron and acid green slime make a strong triad. Shadows are rich, though the grey floor is a little flat.
Green chair on a red-orange gradient with a peach floor; the whole card is pulled warm. The hero green still contrasts well. The flat peach block looks slightly off.
